consequence.statement: Kyverno controllers can no longer view all resources (including custom resources) through the removed wildcard view permission, which may impact reports and mutate/generate policies on custom resources; admission control policies are not impacted.
consequence.remediation: Check the Role Based Access Controls documentation and grant view access for custom resources used by reports, mutate or generate policies.

assertion.statement: In 1.13 the wildcard view permission of the Kyverno controllers was removed and a role binding to the default `view` role was added, so controllers may no longer view custom resources, which can affect reports and mutate/generate policies on custom resources.

checks.detail: rbac-permission:kyverno|name=*/view: source render absent, target render absent — not visible with chart defaults
